title: The alpha's toll
text: The harem is fracturing — jealousy, slammed doors, competing mouths at midnight. Your alpha corners you: 'Handle this. Tonight. Or I walk, and they all walk with me.'

effects.tpl: You disappear with the alpha until dawn — worship, sweat, promises kept on skin. The house exhales. Everyone sleeps in the same bed of quiet.
Screaming, tears, a thrown shoe. Nobody leaves, but everybody remembers who didn't show up. The tension stays — it just goes quiet.
